name: Crown Jewel
text: When this card wins a trick, gain +25 contract value.
archetypes: High Card; splash Spade Master, Bonus Chaser
decision: When to cash the face card: once the higher cards of its suit are gone, or as a trump if it is a spade.
opponent: Visible on trigger; opponents can trump or overtake the card to deny it.
aiNote: Play the engraved card once it is the highest card of its suit still out, or trump with it if it is a spade.
rationale: Engraving places it on a face card, which wins about 40% of the time, so this is about 10 expected points per round: a king pays often, and a jack waits for the higher cards of its suit to fall.
deviation: Affinity changed from Ace to Spade, then dropped once Engraving sigils began preferring face cards, which already vary from hand to hand.
